correctness.rationale: The geometric Picard form, sixteen (-1)-curve classes and W(D5) reflections are explicit. Exhaustive generation yields 1920 distinct elements and eighteen conjugacy classes whose sizes sum to 1920. Unimodular integer kernel transformations find primitive invariant lattices, exact Smith forms yield all trace cokernels, and enumeration of all (r-1)-fold independent supporting hyperplanes yields all nef rays. A separate Smith pass checked every trace index; the unique index-16 class has exact representative, invariant basis and coordinate matrix exhibited in RESULT.md. All statements are conditional on an actual Frobenius class.

value.rationale: The sixteen (-1)-curves are canonical geometric generators on every smooth quartic del Pezzo. Whether their Galois traces saturate the actual integral arithmetic Picard lattice is a natural descent invariant not determined by the rational effective cone. The fully classified exceptional (Z/4)^2 index-16 obstruction and the differing effective/nef ray profiles (including rank-four 8/10 and 8/6) are structural, reusable facts for arithmetic divisors and positivity.
